pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭessanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhuniyo dve ekattharaṇapāpuraṇā tuvaṭṭeyyuṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc32:2.1.6: taññeva attharitvā taññeva pārupanti āpatti pācittiyassa.
